#### Manage your subscription

# Which payment methods can I use?

You can pay for **The X Subscription** on the web with these payment methods:

* Cards
* Apple Pay
* Google Pay
* Link

If checkout doesn't accept the payment method on your current plan, choose another supported method, or keep your current plan, price, and features. Some payment methods are only available in certain countries. Checkout shows the ones you can use.

## Other reasons you may be unable to switch to The X Subscription

* If you pay for Cursor through the Apple App Store, you can switch on the web, but we can't cancel or refund your Apple subscription. After you switch, cancel it in your iPhone or iPad Settings, or Apple keeps billing you. Request any refund from Apple.
* If you already have a Cursor, SuperGrok, or X Premium subscription, switch on the web. Switching in the mobile apps isn't available yet.
* If you’re on an Enterprise team, work with your account manager to see if you’re eligible to switch.
* If you have an unpaid invoice or past-due payment, you will be unable to switch until it is settled.
* Some account setups may require help from Support before you can continue.

## Manage your payment method

After you switch, add or update your payment method in your billing settings at [grok.com/dashboard](https://grok.com/dashboard).
